g.text: Responses API, grounded on queried rows
⑥ called by both API identities
① Sign in with Entra ID (MSAL redirect, PKCE)
② HTTPS to Front Door with the bearer token
③ Private Link to the environment's apps
④ API validates the JWT: issuer, audience, Cost.Read
⑤ Cost query with the API managed identity
⑥ Foundry answer grounded on the queried rows
⑧ GitHub OIDC → Azure (no stored secrets)
⑨ Build → ACR → deploy by digest
